name: On-call incident: payments retry storm
description: A telemetry agent watches the fleet, a triage agent interprets what it sees, and a deploy agent can act, while the on-call engineer is asleep.

decisions.reasoning: Shipped confirm-or-defer for the 3am page; there wasn't time to build a working correction path, and the team accepted that gap to ship the checkpoint at all rather than skip it.

removedElementReasons.sith-correct-interpretation: No correction path yet. If triage's read is wrong, the only way to catch it tonight is to defer and page a human, not to fix triage's interpretation in place.
